a: Covers housing, meals and travel, plus a stipend and the North America Symposium
dt: Applications open around Nov 1, 2026; due Feb 1, 2027 at all 14 host sites
e: US citizens or permanent residents; sophomores, juniors and non-graduating seniors with a GPA of at least 3.2 who intend to pursue a PhD or MD-PhD. Yale is a host, and students may apply to other hosts. The program was renewed by the Amgen Foundation in Nov 2025.
